title: Book 5 — Terpsichore, Chapter 80
paragraphs: While they were discussing it thus, at length one of them perceived “what the oracle means to tell us. Asopus is said to have had two daughters born to him, Thebe and Aegina; and as these are sisters, I think the god has given us as his answer that we should ask the men of Aegina to become our helpers.” Since there seemed to be no better opinion expressed than this, they at once sent and asked the men of Aegina to help them, calling upon them in accordance with the oracle; and the Aeginetans, when the request was made, said that they were sending them the sons of Aeacus as helpers.
